Lessons.Title: Add, Subtract, and Multiply Fractions
ExplanationParagraphs:
Learning goal: You will represent and solve problems involving fraction operations.
In this lesson, you practice multiplying a fraction and a whole number and adding and subtracting fractions, including mixed numbers. You rely on your understanding of equivalence and the properties of operations to decompose fractions, whole numbers, and mixed numbers to enable comparison, addition, subtraction, and multiplication (MP7).

2021 source activity sequence: Warm-up: Number Talk: Fluency and Fractions (10 minutes); Activity 1: Let’s Make Head Wraps! (15 minutes); Activity 2: Make 2 Yards of Fabric (10 minutes); Activity 3: Play by the Rules (10 minutes); Cool-down: Compare to 2 (5 minutes)
Math focus: Add or multiply fractional lengths by counting equal-size unit-fraction parts; compare results with benchmark whole numbers.
Worked Edulytics example: Jada joins five pieces, each 2/6 yard long. Total length is 5 × 2/6 = 10/6 yard. Convert 10/6 to 1 4/6 = 1 2/3 yards and compare with whole yards.
First-party Edulytics Cool-down (publisher's original not inspected): Three pieces are each 3/4 yard. What is their total length?
